hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Inner sleeve
function: The inner tube, held closed by shear screws, that the seated ball pushes toe-ward to uncover the ports.

tabs.overview: Shifts a few inches on the ball's pressure differential; seals above and below the ports hold pressure until it moves; a lock keeps it open afterwards.
tabs.engineering: Shear value set above the casing test pressure and below the frac pressure.
tabs.safety: Left open after the job; milled with the seat where the drift is needed.
tabs.evidence: Completion codes article (S34), ball injector patent (S35), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
